# The combo pauses during the lock; the unlock leaves it paused.
@0 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 provisional
@100 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 confirmed
@300 suspended lock
@2600 paused
@3000 unsuspended
@6100 resumed
